text: That rim is not a fixed ring.
It is an iris, on a track, with leaves that open and close like a camera aperture.
Watch the contact points move inward, then outward.
So one pad takes a twenty foot dome or a forty foot one without being rebuilt.
That is the whole reason a host can serve a range of domes with a single piece of hardware.
The mechanism is a development concept, and it belongs in the upgrade column.
